proposals.form: A name for one concept: 文 as a single character, status 古, cluster C08 (knowing), marked as an AI reading. 所取之义: differing things crossing and readable, taken along steps. 不带: the senses 文饰 and 文采之美 (ornament, beauty), 文德 and the posthumous-title sense, 文质 as personal cultivation, 人文之教化, and the 吉凶 of 「文不當，故吉凶生焉」.
proposals.concept: 文 is the course of a history through a map: the values a reading gives a history step by step, o n = f (g n), with no configuration given. In Lean this is Parting.course reg r, and more generally any o : Nat → O, which Lean already calls a course. The states and the law (its 理) are read off the 文. Draft 經 using only adopted names: 「文，一历经一象逐步所现之值也。文之二时，其后皆同，则二时同；同者次时亦同：文之法自文读出。法下之行，文之二时同，恰当其状于此象之框中同。文之同类有穷，恰当其二时同。文之同类不过 N，则二时同，恰当其后 N＋N－1 步皆同。」
proposals.anchor: Definition: Becoming.Parting.course ("the course of a run through the map"), with Becoming.SameAhead (two moments are one state when everything after them is alike through the map). Laws: Becoming.alike_moments_iff (every course is the law of moments read through the map, and its alike moments are exactly its one-state moments, so states and law are read off with no configuration given); Becoming.SameAhead.next (the states go on as themselves, so their law is read off too); Becoming.IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike (under a determined law, one state of the course holds exactly where the configurations are alike in the frame by the map); Becoming.finitely_many_states_iff (finitely many states exactly where two moments are one state, that is, where the values repeat from some moment on); Becoming.Identification.sameAhead_iff_below (with at most N states, N+N−1 steps decide, and this is exact by Becoming.Identification.bounded_agree_exact); Becoming.Law.const_identifiesAlike_iff (the counterpart of 物一無文); Becoming.SameAhead.new_each; Becoming.Learning.prefixOf (往 is a course's prefix). Every name resolves through resolve.py and is listed in the pure-core receipt becoming-checks/20261022T040548.209667Z. The model fixes three things: a discrete shared step index (Nat), values compared by equality, and, for sameAhead_iff_below, a bound N that has to be given.
proposals.quote: Name's 引: 「物相杂，故曰文」@DS03 (checked with ctq). Law's 对照: 「剛柔交錯，天文也……觀乎天文，以察時變」@YD-JP22 (checked with ctq). Support checked with ctq: 「通其变，遂成天下之文」@DS02, 「理者，成物之文也」 and 「凡理者，方圓、短長、麤靡、堅脆之分也」@CV1-S-JL, 「合奏以成文者也」@RU2-S-XZ20. Support checked by script against the repository's own frozen files: 「物一无文」 with 韦昭's note 「五色杂，然后成文」@P06 (atlas-v9.1, 国语·郑语), 「文：錯畫也。象交文。」@wikisource 說文解字/09, 「知分理之可相別異也」@V4MO003 (说文解字叙).
proposals.neighbours: 状: what the unfolding is at one step (Alike). 文 gives no configuration, only values along steps; under a determined law, one state of the 文 holds exactly where the 状 are 同 in the frame by the 象 (sameAhead_iff_alike). 象 / 像: 象 is the map itself and 像 is its value at one 者, so 文 is the 像 of a 历 taken step by step. 类: the states of a 文 are a 类 of its moments, the lumping by 同 (alike_moments_iff). 理: a 类 that carries a law. A 文's own 理 is that lumping, which goes on as itself under the law of moments (SameAhead.next). 理 is read off 文 and is not 文 itself, so 「理者，成物之文也」 stays 定域, as the name table already reads it: carrying a law is the theory's added condition. 读: (一·三) giving values by a 象, the act; 文 is what 读 yields along a history. 讀（AI） stays the edition's status mark. 辨: a 码 tells senses apart (injective), while a 文 tells moments apart by what follows them; these are different objects, joined in classical usage by 说文's 斐「分別文也」. 名 / 码 / 义项: the sign layer (依类象形 is one 名 per class under a 码) stays with them. A written text is a 文 only as a course of 名 read through a 码; 文 does not name the sign. 符: an extrapolation accords with a 文 (Learning.Accords pred o); 往 is a 文's prefix (prefixOf). Not in the list but needed: 歷 is configurations and moves, and 自然之法 (Shown) is the law a 歷 shows when configurations are given. A 文's law of moments is read with none given.
proposals.case: Philology by period. (1) The graph. 说文 glosses 文 as 「錯畫也。象交文」, crossed strokes that image crossing lines. Background I could not check, because the repository corpora do not hold it: the oracle-bone and bronze graph is a frontal figure with a chest marking, and 文 is the Western Zhou ancestor epithet (文王, 文考). (2) Spring–Autumn speeches, compiled in the Warring States. 史伯: 「聲一無聽，物一無文」, so 文 needs more than one kind. 成鱄 (左传, 昭公二十八年): 「經緯天地曰文」@P07, 文 as warp crossing weft. 杨倞's note on 荀子: 「青與赤謂之文」@RU2-S-XZ05. (3) 论语. 文 is cultivated form against native stuff, 「質勝文則野」@RU1-S-LY, and the inherited culture. (4) The Warring States defining layer. 「物相雜，故曰文」 defines 文 by differing things mixed together. 「剛柔交錯，天文也……觀乎天文，以察時變」 makes the crossing a succession that is read to discern change. 「通其變，遂成天下之文」 has 文 completed by carrying through the changes. 「合奏以成文」: music's 文 is a course of differing sounds. In 解老, 理 is the 文 of formed things, namely their divisions (方圓短長之分), and things with a 定理 come and go (「定理有存亡」). 「文理密察，足以有別也」@R04: 文理 fine enough to tell things apart. (5) Han. 说文叙 derives writing from reading the world's 文: 「視鳥獸之文」, then 「知分理之可相別異也，初造書契」, then 「依類象形，故謂之文……文者，物象之本；字者，言孳乳而寖多也」@V4MO003. (6) Qing. 戴震: 「理者，察之而幾微必區以別之名也，是故謂之分理……曰文理」@RU2-S-V3Q01. The root. Every later sense keeps three components of 錯畫: (a) differing elements (物一無文); (b) their crossing (交錯, 經緯, 雜); (c) being readable (察, 別, 分理之可相別異). The trunk is the 易传 sense: differing things crossing, read for change. 说文叙 itself states that writing branches from this, and 人文, 文质 and 文德 apply it to human order and display. So the name should take the trunk, not a branch. The structure. The core has an object with exactly these three components: a history read through a map, step by step. (a) Differing: where the map shows no difference ahead, lumping everything into one is exact (Law.const_identifiesAlike_iff), which is the structure of 物一無文; where every value is new, each moment is its own state (SameAhead.new_each). (b) Crossing: a 文 is neither the 歷 alone nor the 象 alone but the one read through the other. (c) Readable: its states and law are read off it with no configuration given (alike_moments_iff, SameAhead.next), which is the structure of 察時變. Under a determined law its states are exactly the configurations alike through the map (sameAhead_iff_alike), close to 「文者，物象之本」. It has finitely many states exactly where it repeats, and with at most N states, N+N−1 steps decide them exactly. This is the precise content of 读书百遍其义自见, with its limits kept. A finite text is a 往: rereading it adds no data, and the prefix fixes only what the bound lets it fix. At a 衢 no extrapolation is right on both runs (Parting.not_right_on_both). The diagonal limit stands (Diagonal.gap_unsaid). The integration. The name gives 篇九 a centre: 文, then 往 (prefixOf, a course's prefix), 知来, 符 / 不符 (Accords pred o), 可知, 有界则往定其行, 衢 (PartAt on courses), and 读不尽其所读. 文理生生's own working definition of 文¹, 「有差异的成分，在一定关系与时序中呈现出的可辨样态」 (03 §一), describes this same structure, reached independently. Naming rules. 文 is neither adopted nor declined: it is absent from names-decisions.tsv and from symbols-not-adopted.tsv. The concept is now called 历程 informally (九·三十三 「二历程」 and the gloss of 往), which is not an adopted name, so this names an unnamed concept rather than starting a renaming sweep. Costs and what would change it. The synchronic 纹 (a hide's pattern at once, six lines at once) is not a course. It is a configuration's value through a map, and that already has the names 像 and 状值. The name follows the 易传 trunk, not the graph's concrete origin. If the edition needs the synchronic sense named, the split 像 (one step) versus 文 (along steps) is already in place. Edits to make by proposal: (i) in YI-ZHUAN row p-wen-budang, 「物相杂，故曰文」 becomes 定域, a 文 having as many states as its reading tells apart, while 文不当 → 吉凶 stays 相分; (ii) 九·三十三 「二历程」 becomes 「二文」; (iii) 往 becomes 「文至某步之前段」; (iv) 凡例's 古典之文 stays, as an instance: a classical text is a course of signs read through a code.

proposals.form: A role term of the edition, defined in 凡例, not a 經 name.
proposals.concept: 文 names the layer of signs that the 中华本 reads and writes in: the classical texts compared in 对照 (古典之文) and the 經's own wording. A method sentence 「以文求理」 (from the 文 that is read to the 理 that carries its law) stands beside 以明 (凡·一) as the edition's account of its own epistemology. The laws stay in 篇九 under their present names: 可知, 往, 知来, 有界则往定其行.
proposals.anchor: None: a role term has no Lean anchor. The method would cite Becoming.Learnable.learnable_iff, Becoming.Learning.determines_lumped_iff and Becoming.Identification.bounded_agree as its laws. The course itself stays unnamed (历程).
proposals.quote: 「倉頡之初作書也，蓋依類象形，故謂之文……文者，物象之本」@V4MO003 (atlas-v9.1 说文解字叙, checked by script). 「君子博學於文，約之以禮」@RU1-S-LY (checked with ctq).
proposals.neighbours: 讀（AI，D62） marks a reading's status. 文 would mark the evidence layer that the reading reads, and 以明 names the method. 名 / 码 / 义项 keep the sign structure inside the 經. 状, 象, 像, 类, 理, 辨 and 符 are unchanged. 读 (一·三) stays the act of giving values by a 象.
proposals.case: For. The 中华本 already uses 文 this way: its 凡例 compares 古典之文 with the laws in three relations. 说文叙 is where 文 becomes the term for written signs, and its own genealogy (視鳥獸之文, then 知分理之可相別異, then 依類象形) gives the epistemology as the origin of writing. 文理生生 forbids coercing text, representation and world object into one another (the forbidden_coercions entry under 文 in the 08 dictionary). Ren's message agrees that 文 is not wholly relational and that not all 文 is core. A role term respects all three: it puts 文 at the centre of the edition's method without asserting one structure for all of its layers. Against. It names the medium, not a structure. The epistemology gets no name on the spine, the course keeps an informal word, and 'the epistemology of 文 is the core's own' becomes a description of method rather than a checked law. When to use it. Use it only if proposal 1's choice of the 易传 trunk over the synchronic 纹 is judged too narrow. It is compatible with proposal 1: under proposal 1 a classical text is a 文 (a course of signs read through a code), so proposal 1 contains this use as an instance.

proposals.form: Not a name: add 文 to symbols-not-adopted.tsv with 道, 气 and 性, and keep it as a word of the 說 only.
proposals.concept: 文 stays the general word for the meeting of a 歷 and a 象. Its structural parts are covered by names already adopted: 状, 象 / 像, 类, 理, 读, 辨, 名 / 码.
proposals.quote: 「物相杂，故曰文；文不当，故吉凶生焉」@DS03 (checked with ctq): the defining passage joins 文 to 吉凶. 「理者，成物之文也」@CV1-S-JL (checked with ctq): 文 is the genus, and the theory names its lawful species 理.
proposals.neighbours: 理 would carry the whole epistemic weight (a lumping that carries the law), and 可知 / 往 / 知来 carry the learning laws. 像 and 状值 cover synchronic pattern, and 名 / 码 / 义项 cover signs. The course stays 历程, used informally.
proposals.case: For. Under AGENTS.md a name is adopted only where the statement means exactly that, and 文 spans graph, pattern, text, culture, virtue and an honorific epithet. The defining 易传 passage ties 文 to 吉凶 (the YI-ZHUAN chapter reads it as 相分). 解老 already gives the lawful part to 理. Against. It leaves the centre Ren asked for without a name. It discards the one classical word whose layers (察時變, 分理之可相別異, 文理足以有別) say exactly what the core's knowing laws prove. And 篇九 keeps using an unnamed object (o : Nat → O) throughout. This is the least fitting option; it is listed so the boundary is explicit.

notes:
Recommendation: proposal 1. Make 文 a 經 name (古, AI reading) for the course of a history through a map: Becoming.Parting.course and any o : Nat → O, with Becoming.SameAhead for its states. The laws that read its states and its law off it with no configuration given are already in the pure core: alike_moments_iff, SameAhead.next, IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike, finitely_many_states_iff, Identification.sameAhead_iff_below with bounded_agree_exact, and Law.const_identifiesAlike_iff. This puts the epistemology of 文 on the spine as the centre of 篇九 without new Lean.

Philological finding. The root is 錯畫 / 交文 (说文): differing strokes crossing. Every later sense keeps three components: differing elements (物一無文), their crossing (交錯, 經緯, 雜), and being readable (察時變, 分理之可相別異, 文理足以有別). The trunk is the Warring States 易传 sense of crossing read for change. 文字 branches from it (说文叙 says so itself), and so do 人文, 文质 and 文德. 文理生生's working definition of 文¹ (03 §一) converges on the same structure independently.

Checks. ctq.py, against the frozen texts of 《中华思想脉络》: DS03 物相杂故曰文 and 彰往而察来; YD-JP22 剛柔交錯天文也 / 觀乎天文以察時變; DS02 通其变遂成天下之文; CV1-S-JL 理者成物之文也, 凡理者…之分也 and 定理有存亡; RU1-S-LY 質勝文則野 and 博學於文; RU2-S-XZ20 合奏以成文; RU2-S-XZ05 (杨倞's note) 青與赤謂之文; RU2-S-XZ19 伪者文理隆盛也; RU2-S-V3Q01 分理 / 文理. The ctq corpus lacks 国语, 左传, 说文 and 中庸's 文理密察, so those were checked by script against the repository's own frozen files under sources/chinese-classical-texts/: P06 物一无文 with 韦昭's note, and 和实生物; P07 经纬天地曰文 (the atlas titles the file 昭公二十年, but it is the whole 昭公 page, and the passage is 昭公二十八年); V4MO003 说文叙 (知分理之可相別異, 依類象形故謂之文, 文者物象之本, 字者孳乳而寖多); wikisource/說文解字__09.json (文：錯畫也。象交文; 斐：分別文也); R04 文理密察足以有別也; IS05 形体色理以目异. Not checked, because no corpus holds them: the oracle-bone and bronze graph forms, the Western Zhou epithet usage, 礼记·乐记 声成文, and 文心雕龙·原道. These are treated as background only.

Lean. Every anchor resolves through resolve.py and appears in the pure-core receipt becoming-checks/20261022T040548.209667Z. 文 appears neither in names-decisions.tsv (447 names) nor in symbols-not-adopted.tsv. Shown already carries 自然之法 and 歷 names histories, so 文 must not take either.

Edits that would follow from proposal 1, all by proposal and none made: in YI-ZHUAN-AND-BECOMING row p-wen-budang, the first clause becomes 定域 and 吉凶 stays 相分; 九·三十三 「二历程」 becomes 「二文」; the gloss of 往 becomes 「文至某步之前段」; 凡例's 古典之文 stays as an instance (a text is a course of signs).

Limits to state wherever the reading is used. The laws rest on a discrete shared step index, on equality of values and on a given bound N. Rereading a finite text adds no data, and the prefix fixes only what the bound lets it fix. 衢 and the diagonal remain real limits. The synchronic 纹 sense stays with 像 / 状值.
